hits.draft_en: A Marvel producer is now running DC. Jeremy Latcham replacing Gunn and Safran is either the smartest or the strangest move Warner and Paramount could make. Smart or strange?

hits.name: DiscussingFilm
hits.text:
One of the reasons Skydance replaced James Gunn and Peter Safran as the heads of DC Studios had to do with box office.

• ‘Supergirl’ was a massive bomb this year.

• ‘Superman’s $618M box office was not impressive to Skydance either, as the film lacked “pop culture impact” in
hits.hook: One of the reasons Skydance replaced James Gunn and Peter Safran as the heads of DC Studios had to do with box office.
hits.draft_en: James Gunn didn't get fired for bad movies. He got fired for movies that didn't feel like events. Superman made $618M and it still wasn't enough for the new owners. What does a DC film need now to count as a hit?
hits.video_tip: 15-second talking head over a quick box-office graphic (Superman $618M, Supergirl, Clayface), end on the question as on-screen text.

patterns: DC shakeup is the whole day: DiscussingFilm's 'James Gunn and Peter Safran will no longer run DC Studios' hit 17,085,921 views, with FilmUpdates' version at 2,108,000. Then the same story got sliced into 10+ follow-up angles that each cleared 440K to 3.8M: Skydance's box-office reasons (3,808,448), Gunn's statement (2,254,262), the scrapped Batman / Justice League roadmap (2,161,292), 'DCU plans mostly dismantled' (1,882,902), how they found out (996,482).

Games crossover on film accounts: GTA 6 'gone gold' 2,275,354, '30FPS on all consoles' 1,355,583, new teaser 734,160, screenshots 334,579, most pre-ordered PlayStation game 186,176. Marvel Rivals Season 11 trailer added 154,224.
